project_info.theme: conservative restoration of an attached family portrait with an adult and baby
project_info.color_palette: source-faithful natural color and original interior tones

main_subject.type: family members shown in the attached archival photograph
main_subject.detail: Preserve exactly the visible adult and baby identities, age presentation, expression, pose, hand placement, clothing, background curtain, and family relationship from the source image.
main_subject.style: faithful archival restoration, not generative restaging

composition_elements.text: Preserve source text only if present; do not add or alter text.
items: match original portrait crop and family grouping
conservatively repair fading, stains, scratches, noise, blur, and paper damage
retain source clothing, interior curtain pattern, and original pose
do not change the baby, adult, or their physical relationship

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: natural skin and fabric detail, restrained denoise, and preserved family-photo character

technical_specs.render_style: non-generative high-resolution restoration comparable to DSLR clarity, exact face and age preservation, subtle source grain, no beauty retouching
technical_specs.resolution: highest recoverable detail at original aspect ratio

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached family photograph into a natural professional high-detail image. Preserve the exact visible adult and baby identities, age presentation, expressions, poses, hand placement, clothing, family relationship, crop, curtain background, and historical character of the source. Repair fading, scratches, stains, noise, blur, and damaged areas conservatively while improving only recoverable clarity and natural color. Do not add or remove people, change any face or age, alter the baby, modify the adult-child relationship, change clothing, hands, background, or pose, or invent details not verified by the original photograph.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, adult age alteration, child age alteration, added person, removed person, changed family relationship, changed pose, changed hand placement, invented clothing, invented background, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed

assets.name: source-family-photo-adult-and-baby
assets.usage: Mandatory source for every adult and child identity, age presentation, pose, hand placement, clothing, relationship, and background.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Original family photo is mandatory. Apply only conservative restoration. Preserve every person exactly as source shows, especially the baby; do not infer or generate uncertain details.
